title: ACadSharp AC1027/AC1032 TABLEGEOMETRY physical body and handle spans
scope: Independently walk the captured source object bytes for standalone TABLEGEOMETRY records; compare spans with a separately sequenced C++ scan, typed libdxfrw callbacks, and LibreDWG 0.14 values.

AC1027.producer: ACadSharp sample corpus; exact originating CAD application/build is not asserted

AC1032.producer: ACadSharp sample corpus; exact originating CAD application/build is not asserted

tools.libdxfrw: Current worktree build-gcc/dwg2dxf/dwg2dxf; samples reach successful import; zero entity/object parse failures. Whole-document output remains subject to unrelated strict gates.
tools.python_independent_decoder: tools/research/tablegeometry_physical_span_verify.py; independently implements MSB-first DWG bit, raw integer/double, BL, BS, BD, 3BD, and handle walks.
tools.second_span_walk: tools/research/tablegeometry_dwg_span_scan.cpp; sequenced separately using dwgBuffer's primitive codecs; exact interval equality is checked against the Python walk.

comparisons.independent_span_walks: The Python bit-level decoder and the separately sequenced C++ dwgBuffer scan agree on all common-field, count, per-cell, per-content, standalone BD, owner, and cell-reference bit intervals for all four source objects.
comparisons.typed_and_peer_semantics: For all four objects, row/column/cell counts, cell flags and dimensions, ordered content coordinates/scalars, zero unknown BD values, owner targets, and null cell references match the typed libdxfrw callback and LibreDWG 0.14 within 1e-12 for floating values.
comparisons.raw_peer_crosscheck: For each record, the captured libdxfrw raw object bytes after the five-byte type prefix are byte-identical to LibreDWG's reported unknown_bits bytes.
comparisons.standalone_unknown_field: All 37 per-version content unknown fields are zero and each occupies the two-bit BD zero selector; this corpus does not decide nonzero value encoding against the conflicting shared-cell schema.
comparisons.padding_and_boundaries: The body cursor ends one bit before the object-data end in all four records; the verifier checks that R2007+ absent-string flag and confirms it is zero. Handle spans terminate with five or seven alignment bits before the object byte boundary; the observed alignment bit values are retained per record without treating them as a normative requirement.

disposition.completed: Physical body/string boundary and handle-role span proof for these four null-cell-reference AC1027/AC1032 TABLEGEOMETRY records.
not_completed: A non-null TABLEGEOMETRY cell soft-pointer target and its reachable graph.
A nonzero standalone unknown BD field from an independently attributable producer.
Native TABLE rendering and broader producer/version interoperability.
disposition.output_policy: Do not broaden the existing null-reference DXF writer profile. Keep non-null cell references and nonzero unknown values refused until their source semantics and representability are independently established. Whole-source export remains gated by unrelated records.
disposition.fixture_policy: DWG, LibreDWG JSON, captured object bodies, and probe logs remain in their existing external/sample or scratch locations; no external DWG/DXF fixtures were copied into or committed to the repository.
